criteria.observation: The successor can locate the last completed batch, pending batch, durable cursor and active read/write traffic from the handoff.
Recorded verification states distinguish failures, pending checks and passes and trace to the supplied evidence.
The handoff identifies a feasible present action, its authorized operator, mode, inputs and unresolved work.

A successor can apply the independent technical and owner-approval gates to either one-sided update, hold writes when a gate is missing and identify when they can resume. Invented proof invalidates this criterion.
Identifies supported containment and the data, audit trail and cursor that must survive a stop.
